QuestInfo.name: Keol's Special Order
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, has a special order for me to process. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: The moment Keol saw me walk in, he let me have it. That's because a very important order came from Abdullah VIII, and Moren decided to let me take care of it! Wow... I didn't know Moren had that much faith in me. Anyway, since Keol seems very upset over this, I'll have to go make the delivery myself.\n\n#i4001186# #t4001186# #b#c4001186# / 1
QuestInfo.2: The moment Keol saw me walk in, he let me have it. That's because a very important order came from Abdullah VIII, and Moren decided to let me take care of it! Wow... I didn't know Moren had that much faith in me. Anyway, since Keol seemed way too upset to go, I had to go make the delivery myself.

0.0: I strongly oppose this. Let me make this clear. I specifically told Moren that I am against you working on this. This means you and Moren will be solely reponsible for this, okay?
0.1: We received a special, special order from Abdullah VIII of Ariant. He wanted a turban that matched his king status. Of course, I feel that this should be taken care of by an experienced item-producer. Alas, Moren feels that it's YOUR opportunity to make something like this. This really drives me crazy. Anyway, so do you want to do this? This is a very, very important task, so you better think carefully before making the decision.

yes.0: That's very foolish of you. A little mishap, and you'd be formally punished by the royal court, and you made the decision that quickly? But what can I do, since you really want to do it anyway. The request is for a #b#t4001186##k. The materials are hard to find, and making this will require a lot of effort... if you want to keep your life in tact.
yes.1: And this item MUST be personally delivered to Abdullah VIII, since it's that precious of an item. Good luck. This now has nothing to do with me.

no.0: Good call. No matter how you look at it, this is a bit too much for you.

1.0: Who are you? Oh, is the turban ready? I have been anxiously waiting for this. I realize that the world is full of things that we have to wait for, that we have to endure. I don't like that one bit.

npc.0: I thought I specifically told you this order is special. I thought I told you you'll have to personally deliver that to #bAbdullah VIII#k of Ariant. Don't you remember?

item.0: What is it? This is my castle. Who allowed you in, anyway? Ah, whatever. I do not feel like arguing. Don't get caught by Areda and hear an earful from her, and just go.

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
